definitions.depth_mm: inward distance from the shared board edge to the deepest U track
definitions.track_count: number of straight segments parallel to the shared edge with length >= 0.5 mm
definitions.nesting: inner U nests in outer U when its along-edge interval is contained in the outer interval and its track is deeper
definitions.adjacent_u_spacing: consecutive U tracks per side with overlapping along-edge intervals; exact minimum centreline distance between the two routes
definitions.bundle: overlapping U intervals within a depth band of 0.16 mm

notes: all values are per plane (the two heights are independent 2D problems); no cross-height U interaction is claimed
shape/U features come from saved primitives only
